test_case: COAWST Projects/Inlet_test/Coupled (official COAWST test application INLET_TEST; ROMS + SWAN coupled through MCT)

engine.name: COAWST
engine.binary: coawstM built for INLET_TEST (header Projects/Inlet_test/Coupled/inlet_test.h): /home/server/engine_builds_20261006/coawst/COAWST/coawstM, sha256 c9cfaf10ea99796573d75b1d378cadf73ca15b739ebcc5274922f290e3614e97, built 2026-10-06 from git archive of the commit with the official build_coawst.sh (copy with MY_ROOT_DIR and MCT paths only), gfortran 13.3.0, Open MPI 4.1.6, netCDF-Fortran 4.5.4; build env FC=mpif90 for SWAN's CMake
engine.source: https://github.com/DOI-USGS/COAWST Projects/Inlet_test/Coupled (12 tracked files) + ROMS/External/varinfo.dat, all via git show 79bd6033:<path>, unmodified
engine.license: COAWST: public domain (USGS) + CC0 1.0 (LICENSE.md); ROMS: MIT/X-style (ROMS/License_ROMS.txt); SWAN: GPL-3.0; MCT: Argonne copyright (Lib/MCT/COPYRIGHT)

ki.run_tool: tools/run_coawst.py (--binary, --config coupling_inlet_test.in at the run root, --nprocs 2)

simulation.ocean: ROMS 75x70x8, DT 60 s, NTIMES 720 (12 h), analytical initial/forcing/open-boundary (ANA_*), sediment (suspended sand, bed load, morphology), SSW_BBL, WEC_VF, GLS mixing
simulation.waves: SWAN 76x71 curvilinear, 36 directions, 0.04-1.0 Hz, nonstationary 60 s, 12 h; boundary JONSWAP Hs 1 m Tp 10 s on the north side
simulation.coupling: MCT, ocean<->wave every 600 s (73 exchanges), same grid, no SCRIP interpolation
simulation.command: mpirun -np 2 coawstM coupling_inlet_test.in (via tools/run_coawst.py, run from the folder holding Projects/ and ROMS/)
